title: A Postcard for the Letters
author: T. M. Lockridge
blurb: Sable Blackwood, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
